question_and_gold.question: What was the date of the first recorded successful human treatment using the antibiotic discovered by Alexander Fleming?

original_outcome.actual_final: The date of the first recorded successful human treatment using penicillin (the antibiotic discovered by Alexander Fleming) was **25 November 1930**. This treatment was performed by Cecil George Paine, a pathologist at the Royal Infirmary in Sheffield, who used penicillin to cure eye infections (conjunctivitis) in one adult and three infants.
